newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends at lows in thinly-traded session.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends at lows in thinly-traded session.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled at the day's lows in volume estimated at a light 3,500 lots.
Dealers noted some speculative and local selling, but scale-down trade buying kept the March contract above support seen at 74.30 cents.
Dealers expect prices to ease a bit further Wednesday, and then climb back towards the highs.
"We're rangebound," a trader said, pegging resistance at 75.50 in March.
The market awaits the U.S. Department of Agriculture's monthly supply and demand data, which will be released Feb 12.
The spot March contract ended 0.49 lower at 74.51 cents, traded 74.95 to 74.50. The back months settled 0.50 to 0.20 lower.
